subject: maths
question: Find the curved surface area of cone of radius 12 cm and slant height 14 cm. (Use π = 3.14)
solution:
**Given:**

The radius of the curved surface area = 12 cm

The slant height of the cone = 14 cm

**Formula used:**

Curved surface area of the cone = π × r × l Where, r = Base radius of the cone, and l = slant height of the cone

**Calculation:**

Let the curved surface area of the cone be X

⇒ X = 3.14 × 12 × 14 = 527.52 cm²

**∴ The required result will be 527.52 cm².**
